title: WealthOS QGLP Data Coverage & Evidence Audit

items.question: Has the business sustained ROCE/ROE > 15% across economic cycles?
Does the business possess an identifiable, durable competitive moat (pricing power, switching costs, network effect)?
items.missingReason: Qualitative moat durability evidence not yet indexed from annual reports or concalls. ROCE alone cannot substitute for moat proof.

items.question: Is reinvestment rate matched by incremental return on invested capital (ROIC)?
items.missingReason: Long-term historical 10-year capex series partially available.

items.question: Are there zero adverse regulatory actions, audit qualifications, or related-party siphoning flags?
items.qualitativeEvidence: Auditor report verified clean from FERE database.

items.question: Has management delivered on guidance and publicly declared milestone commitments?
items.qualitativeEvidence: FERE management commitment tracker shows partial delivery.
items.missingReason: Historical concall archive pending multi-year extension.

items.question: Is there a documented leadership succession pipeline and low top-tier executive churn?
items.missingReason: Qualitative succession and corporate culture assessment requires verified governance filings.

items.question: Has top-line revenue demonstrated double-digit compound growth over 3 to 5 years?
Is growth driven by structural volume expansion rather than purely inflationary price hikes?
items.missingReason: Disaggregated volume vs realization data missing for certain segments.

items.question: Does the industry addressable market (TAM) support 10x-30x expansion headroom?
items.missingReason: Industry market share and TAM penetration models require dedicated industry research dossier.

items.question: Is the business model protected from technological or regulatory obsolescence over a 10-20 year horizon?
items.missingReason: Terminal value horizon requires qualitative domain research. Cannot be deduced from financial metrics.

items.question: Does the company ride non-cyclical, secular megatrends (demographics, formalization, digital, decarbonization)?
items.missingReason: Secular theme alignment requires qualitative classification.

items.question: Are customer churn rates low with high lifetime value (LTV/CAC > 3)?
items.missingReason: Customer retention and contract duration metrics not reported in standard regulatory filings.

items.question: Are current valuation multiples (P/E, P/B, EV/EBITDA) reasonable relative to growth rate (PEG <= 1.5)?
Is current valuation within or below the 5-year historical median band?
items.missingReason: 5-year band derived from current snapshot history.

items.question: Does discounted cash flow (DCF) or conservative reproduction cost offer > 25% margin of safety?
items.missingReason: DCF requires explicitly audited cash flow projections, not synthetic formulas.

items.question: Is Debt-to-Equity < 0.5 or Interest Coverage Ratio > 4.0?
Is promoter pledge percentage strictly zero or negligible (< 5%)?
Are there zero material rating downgrades or existential regulatory inquiries?
items.missingReason: Comprehensive court and regulatory legal database feed pending integration.
